channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Car Park Capital
item.description: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

item.title: Cyan Heart
item.description: A horror exploration puzzle adventure where you relive events through a selfie viewpoint. Alone, with only voice communication from comrades as support, she simply keeps the camera rolling. Witness the record she wished to leave behind.

item.title: Foundation Guivre Garden
item.description: The Guivre Garden is an hommage to the guivre, a mythical beast that originated from Medieval France. This special building contains 18 parts, with a main statue and 3 secondary statues.

item.title: Japanese Ramen Simulator
item.description: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

item.title: Keep Watering
item.description: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

item.title: Paradise Killer
item.description: Paradise Island, a world outside reality. There’s been a murder that only "investigation freak" Lady Love Dies can solve. Gather evidence and interrogate suspects in this open world adventure. You can accuse anyone, but you’ll have to prove your case in trial. It’s up to you to decide who’s guilty.

item.title: Solo Cultivation 独修
item.description: Xianxia inspired Cultivation game. Cultivate, farm materials, learn manuals, craft pills and equipments, hunt monsters and fight bosses!

item.title: Stickility
item.description: Explore vast and deep interiors of an underground research center, brimming with creative foes, bosses, NPC's, and more. Craft your equipment from scavenged tech, and uncover Biotec's dark experiments.

item.title: The Long Dark: WINTERMUTE
item.description: The episodic story-mode for The Long Dark, WINTERMUTE, includes four of the five episodes that form WINTERMUTE. Episode Five is in development, and is slated for release at a later date. This will bring the WINTERMUTE storyline to its conclusion.

item.title: Two Point Campus: Medical School
item.description: Enroll in Medical School today! Join wandering paramedic Vitality Johnson to cure the sick, tackle pesky pirates, and embrace yeti wisdom. Your adventures in medicine start here!

item.title: Two Point Campus: Space Academy
item.description: Welcome aboard space cadets, as we boldly go to Two Point County’s Space Academy! Revitalise the County's interest in outer space, one small step at a time, and get your students to reach for the stars, and their wallets.

item.title: Used Cars Simulator
item.description: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

item.title: Afterlove EP
item.description: From the creator of Coffee Talk and What Comes After, comes a slice-of-life adventure set in modern Jakarta about love, loss and finding your own way forward. Step into the shoes of Rama, a young musician struggling to move on with life after the death of his girlfriend, Cinta.

item.title: Astral Ascent - The Outer Reaches
item.description: Explore The Outer Reaches, 4 new worlds with 32 new enemies and face Andromeda boss fight.

item.title: Dawn of Defiance
item.description: Become a Spartan in this Greek myth survival adventure, solo or with up to 3 friends. Explore a realm at the edge of the Underworld, fight mythical beasts, gather resources, craft powerful gear & build grand palaces. Raid ancient temples, seize the iconic weapons of the Olympians, and defy the gods.

item.title: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
item.description: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!

item.title: Duelist: Idle Expedition
item.description: Build your elite team in Duelist: Idle Expedition, the idle auto-battler that lives on your taskbar. Recruit from a pool of 90+ JRPG pixel-art roles and lead your traveling camp to victory against all the powerful Guilds on the Continent. Your epic journey continues even when you are busy!

item.title: Great God Grove
item.description: THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch dialogue in a world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!

item.title: Hood Warfare 2
item.description: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

item.title: The Escapists
item.description: The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of escaping!

item.title: Babel Legacy
item.description: An idle game where you gather resources and grow your city. Sit back and watch your city expand!

item.title: Beacon Pines
item.description: Beacon Pines is a cute and creepy adventure set within a mysterious book. Sneak out late, make new friends, uncover hidden truths, and collect words that will change the course of fate!

item.title: Bering Tonnage
item.description: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

item.title: Birb
item.description: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

item.title: BlazBlue Centralfiction
item.description: Combining a 2D fighting game with a visual novel, the BlazBlue series continues on with massive fan support! The latest installation, BlazBlue: Centralfiction, serves as the ending to the Azure Saga, revealing the hidden truth of the world!

item.title: Castle Crashers - Painter Boss Paradise
item.description: The Painter Boss Paradise DLC provides a fresh coat of paint to Castle Crashers with new main menu art and redraws for all playable characters and weapons! Join Paint Junior, the game’s newest official character, and bring your custom characters to life with the Steam Workshop!

item.title: Crack the Pack
item.description: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 1001 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

item.title: Darkest Dungeon®: The Fire's Edge
item.description: The Fire’s Edge DLC brings two new recruitable heroes - The Runaway and the Duelist - to Darkest Dungeon. New combat mechanics, powerful trinkets, and additional Hamlet districts await!

item.title: Demon General Kirsten
item.description: Kirsten is a soldier troubled by her current way of life. During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people, and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...

item.title: Dread Delusion
item.description: Dread Delusion is an open world RPG brimming with strange places and dark perils. Carve your own path through the flying continents of a shattered land. Discover curious towns, unearth occult secrets, master powerful magic - and change the world through your choices.

item.title: Echo Weaver
item.description: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

item.title: Echoes of Mystralia
item.description: Echoes of Mystralia is an action-heavy spellcrafting ARPG roguelite, where rapid combat meets deep customization. Craft your own spells, unlock new combinations, fight epic bosses, and discover a narrative-rich world that never plays the same twice.

item.title: Forever Ago
item.description: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

item.title: Foundation: Harvest Festival
item.description: Master the land by raising livestock, planting lush orchards, and cultivating hardy new crops. Expand your production chains to create new resources and crown your success by hosting the grandest of Harvest Festivals.

item.title: Gridlords
item.description: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

item.title: Grim Dawn - Steam Loyalist 4 DLC
item.description: This sinister collection of vanity items is guaranteed to help you conquer Grim Dawn's foulest enemies while looking your grimmest.

item.title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus
item.description: Explore islands of ancient legends and mythos, seek the favors of the gods to challenge and defend against Greed of epic scales in this major expansion - Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus.

item.title: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure
item.description: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 13,196 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

item.title: Maid Cafe Simulator
item.description: Run a maid café with five charming kemonomimi maids! Make drinks, serve customers, and tackle troublemakers in this first-person management sim. Get to know the girls behind the aprons as you turn a rundown café into a thriving business and aim for three Maidchelin stars.

item.title: Neon Abyss 2
item.description: Dive into the cybermyth roguelike chaos of Neon Abyss 2! Now featuring up to 4-player online co-op, more combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic, action-packed experience you won't forget.

item.title: Pony Island
item.description: Pony Island is a suspense puzzle game in disguise. You are in limbo, trapped in a malevolent and malfunctioning arcade machine devised by the devil himself. It is not a game about ponies.

item.title: Sort of Magic
item.description: A cozy organizing game for 1–4 players in online co-op. You're a little magical cat who knocked over an entire magic school. Now put all 4,500 books, potions, and brooms back exactly where they belong. Learn sorting spells, split the rooms with friends, and restore the mess you made.

item.title: Sort The Capybaras
item.description: Sort The Capybaras is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,800 unique capybara toys onto the correct shelves. Play with friends or go solo. Enjoy the satisfaction of using powerful skills turning a messy capybara store into a perfectly organized collection.

item.title: Superhero Simulator
item.description: Superhero Simulator is an open-world superhero game where you fight villains and save lives! But being a hero isn’t free! You’ll need to work, pay rent, and survive. Can you handle both sides of the superhero life?

item.title: The Crimson Hunt
item.description: You play as Victoria, a vampire hunter haunted by her past, and Eleanor, a young woman trapped in a nightmare that has only just begun. Together, they must endure grotesque creatures, hidden traps, and a presence that seems to know them better than they realize.

item.title: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
item.description: The grand opening is tomorrow, and someone has helpfully unpacked the entire delivery onto the floor. Pick the flowers up an armful at a time, sort them by species into baskets, paint them in patterns, and have the place ready by morning. No timers, nobody watching. A cozy first-person tidy-up.

item.title: Tower Tactics II
item.description: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

item.title: Toy Shire
item.description: Are you prepared for a thrilling toy army tower defense adventure? Welcome to the Toy Shire! Battle diverse foes in various locations, defend your family, and repel foes from your area. Save the world by strengthening your defense with toy towers!

item.title: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
item.description: Step right up! We’re searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

item.title: Ultra Street Fighter® IV
item.description: The world’s greatest fighting game evolves to a whole new level with Ultra Street Fighter IV.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
item.description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

item.title: Wildaria
item.description: Tame any creature. Ride them into battle. Challenge the Animal Gods. Explore an infinite, procedurally generated fantasy world. Fight, quest, trade, and grow stronger alongside your pets in this open-world action-adventure RPG.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!

item.title: Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack
item.description: A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

item.title: MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries
item.description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.
